# Yohaku Companion v1.9.1

## Fixes and reliability

- Fixed Live Desk playback progress for QQ Music and other players that update MediaRemote elapsed time only at track start or after seeking. Yohaku Companion now advances the reported playhead from the source timestamp and playback rate instead of repeatedly rebasing near 0:00.
- Paused playback remains frozen, and players without a reliable position continue to omit the playhead instead of reporting zero.

## Update notes

- No settings, permissions, or pairing changes are required.
